summary: Removed task-specific tool names (roi_crop, llava_med_qa) from system prompt to fix leakage objection while preserving general skepticism heuristic.

edits.hypothesis: Removing specific tool references (roi_crop, llava_med_qa) from the skepticism instruction prevents task-specific leakage while maintaining the general principle of verifying negative tool outputs via visual inspection.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The reviewer identified hard-coded tool names as a violation of the constitution. A prompt edit is the correct lever to remove these specific references while keeping the strategic intent (skepticism of negative findings).
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M5 arm predictions using AGENT_SYSTEM.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) The agent retains the instruction to verify negative findings visually, which would have helped in q000001/q000002/q000005 by encouraging ROI inspection without mandating a specific unavailable tool. (preservative) Generalizes better to other tasks as it doesn't assume specific tool availability. (transfer) Applies to any diagnostic task where tool sensitivity is limited.
edits.regression_risk: Low; the instruction is now more general and less likely to cause confusion if specific tools are missing.
edits.mechanism: Removing specific tool references (roi_crop, llava_med_qa) from the skepticism instruction prevents task-specific leakage while maintaining the general principle of verifying negative tool outputs via visual inspection.
